title: Tissue Lysis and Digestion for MS Analysis
author: David Kotol
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yguftww
materials: Disrupt the tissue using the Tissue Lyser for 00:02:00 Tissue Lyser LT (QIAGEN, 85600, Bead mill, https://www.qiagen.com/us/shop/automated-solutions/sample-disruption/tissuelyser-lt/#orderinginformation )

Homogenize the tissue using the Tissue Lyser for 00:02:00 Tissue Lyser LT (QIAGEN, 85600, Bead mill, https://www.qiagen.com/us/shop/automated-solutions/sample-disruption/tissuelyser-lt/#orderinginformation )

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Lyser and Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the Tissue Lyser LT (QIAGEN, 85600) and the tissue sample for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the Tissue Lyser adapter on dry ice for 30 minutes.
Add one 3mm Tungsten Carbide Bead (QIAGEN, 69997) to the tissue sample and incubate on dry ice for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Lyse Tissue and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Perform tissue lysis and initial separation.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of Lysis Buffer (7M Urea, 2M Thiourea, 2% SDC).
Centrifuge for 30 minutes at 20,000 × g at 4 °C.

steps.title: Precipitate and Wash Proteins
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins using acetone and clean the resulting pellet.

substeps.instruction: Precipitate proteins with 4 volumes of ice-cold acetone and incubate at -20 °C overnight.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g at 4 °C for 30 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash the pellet twice with 400 µL of ice-cold acetone, centrifuging each time at 20,000 × g at 4 °C for 10 minutes.
Remove excess acetone and dry the pellet.

steps.title: Solubilize and Quantify Protein
steps.instruction: Dissolve the protein pellet and determine the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in 200 µL of Pellet Solubilizer (7M Urea, 2M Thiourea).
Dilute the sample 8 times with 100 millimolar (mM) TEAB.
Measure protein concentration using the Bio-Rad Protein assay (Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #5000001) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Protein Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Prepare the protein sample for digestion through reduction and alkylation.

substeps.instruction: Take a volume corresponding to 15 µg of proteins and add QPrESTs mixture.
Add DTT to a final concentration of 10 millimolar (mM) and incubate for 1 hour at 30 °C.
Add CAA to a final concentration of 50 millimolar (mM) and incubate for 30 minutes in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Digest Proteins
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic digestion and quench the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 ng of Pierce Trypsin protease and incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Quench the digestion by adding TFA to a final concentration of 0.5% (v/v).

steps.title: Prepare and Condition StageTips
steps.instruction: Assemble and prepare StageTips for sample cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one StageTip per sample by inserting 3 layers of Empore Cation Extraction Discs (3M, 2251-1) into a 200 µL tip.
Activate the membrane with 50 µL 100% MeOH and spin at 1000 x g for 1 minute.
Equilibrate the StageTip with 50 µL Wash Buffer (30% MeOH, 0.1% FA) and spin at 1000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Clean Up Samples via StageTip
steps.instruction: Process the digested samples through the StageTips.

substeps.instruction: Apply the sample to the StageTip and spin at 1000 x g for 1 minute.
Wash twice with 30 µL Wash Buffer (30% MeOH, 0.1% FA), spinning at 1000 x g for 1 minute after each wash.
Elute twice with 20 µL Elution Buffer (30% MeOH, 1.65% NH4OH), spinning at 1000 x g for 1 minute after each elution.

steps.title: Dry and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for final MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Vacuum dry the samples for 30 minutes at 42 °C.
Store at -20 °C until MS analysis.

steps.title: Final MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare and inject samples for mass spectrometry.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve samples in Solvent A.
Inject 1.75 µg.
